title: No Halloween winner: Powerball climbs to an estimated $793 million for Monday

content:
No ticket matched all six numbers in Saturday's Halloween Powerball drawing, pushing the jackpot to an estimated $793 million for Monday night's drawing.

Saturday's winning numbers were 2, 4, 18, 50 and 56, with a Powerball of 20 and a Power Play multiplier of 3x. Saturday's jackpot had been advertised at $760 million for most of the week and reached an estimated $770 million by drawing time on late ticket sales, according to Powerball reporting.

Three tickets matched all five white balls, according to the Detroit Free Press: a North Carolina ticket that also played Power Play won $2 million, while tickets in Georgia and the United Kingdom won $1 million each.

Monday's drawing is at 10:59 p.m. Eastern — 9:59 p.m. Central — on November 2. The winner would choose between the $793 million paid out over time or a $339.9 million cash option, both before taxes. A ticket costs $2, and the odds of winning the jackpot are 1 in 292.2 million.

The jackpot was last won on August 12, when a ticket sold in Illinois claimed an estimated $1.04 billion prize.

For Webb County players, the Monday drawing falls the night before Election Day — a reminder that the lottery drawing and the election are separate events on separate nights, even as both dominate the week's conversation.
